minutes.headline: Water commissioners put the rate increase off to a later meeting and moved the truck bid opening to Nov 16.
minutes.summary: The Water Commissioners reviewed bills and the first loan payment on the new building, pushed the water rate discussion to a later meeting so a member could review new paperwork, and discussed the O'Brien Homes Howard Street request ahead of a ZBA meeting. The superintendent reported a conservation denial of a notification waiver for the Mass Ave water main and a delayed truck bid. September 28 minutes were approved and the board adjourned.

Members remarked that electric bills from Unitil are very high.
First annual payment on the building loan, with heavy interest up front and payments rising toward the end of a long term.
Rate increase discussion deferred to a later meeting for review of new paperwork.
Cost of serving the development can't be estimated without a design; board has no obligation to supply water.
The engineer will bill the district directly rather than through Stantec because of the extra conservation work.
Bid for a new truck bed with steel versus aluminum alternate; bids to open November 16th.

what_happened.line: The Water Commissioners put off the water rate increase discussion to a later meeting so a member could review new paperwork.
The board decided to take no further action on O'Brien Homes water for Howard Street and to send a letter to the ZBA, citing no obligation to supply water.
Truck bids are to be opened at 4 pm on November 16th, and the board may move its meeting from the 23rd to the 16th.
The board reviewed bills, including a bond payment due November 1st and the first annual payment on the building loan.
The engineer will bill the district directly for extra conservation work on the Mass Ave water main rather than through Stantec.

why_it_matters: The water rate decision was not made, so any change to residents' water bills waits for a later meeting.
The building loan and the extra engineering and conservation work are costs the district carries, and they bear on the rate discussion that was deferred.
watch_next: The next Water Commissioners meeting, where the deferred rate increase discussion is expected to return.
